start.speaker: Narrator
start.text: The box spins around, making you dizzy, and then stops. Kronos kicks you out of the box and in an instance your view changes to a path surounded of bambu with a shrine at the end of it

HI2.speaker: Player
HI2.text: Wow *looks around with shiny eyes*, this is so cozy!

HI3.speaker: Kronos
HI3.text: Don't let the view, neither the one living here, fool you. Many pretty things are dangerous.

HI4.speaker: Player
HI4.text: what do you mean? Are there ninjas in the forest? ancient traps? Is the only food here cake or something?

HI5.speaker: Kronos
HI5.text: Oh you wish it was cake indigestion your worst worry. Nope it's sth worse

HI6.speaker: Narrator
HI6.text: Just when kronos finish his ominous sentence, a slender figure appears from behind the shrine and in a blink of an eye it's behind kronos

HI7.speaker: Benten
HI7.text: Oh it's you dear Kronos, You came back. How delightful!

HI8.speaker: Narrator
HI8.text: The figure's voice is soft but doesn't hesistate. You watch as the figure invades (a lot) kronos personal space, Kronos stays still without uttering a word and you get the impression he wants to go back into the box.

HI10.speaker: Kronos
HI10.text: *sighs* This is benten. Benten, meet my new friend

HI11.speaker: Narrator
HI11.text: Benten didn't even realized you were there. When she notices your presence, she hides behind kronos, although she fails to do so because of her height.

HI12.speaker: Narrator
HI12.text: A moment after, she takes a peek at you, her expression rather flustered, and quickly she goes back into hiding. Time waiting for her increases as does your confussion.

HI13.speaker: Narrator
HI13.text: Finally, she comes out and starts walking towards you. She carries herself with grace before stopping in front of you.

HI14.speaker: Benten
HI14.text: *in a soft, sweet, low voice* Pleased to meet you, handsome. I'm Beten, I like the flow of things. Pardon my behaviour earlier, I really hope that I didn't scare you *looks ashamed*

HI15.speaker: Player
HI15.text: Hi miss Benten, I'm a friend of Kronos. The pleasure is mine. I don't know what the flow of things is but good for you!

HI16.speaker: Narrator
HI16.text: When you mention her name, she makes a bashful expression. You are unsure of how to act around her so for now you stick to being friendly and trying not to be awkward

HI17.speaker: Benten
HI17.text: Well, now that we are acquainted, To what do I owe your presence here?

HI18.speaker: Kronos
HI18.text: Ohh yes, dear Benten we're actually-

HI19.speaker: Benten
HI19.text: *in a firm voice* I didn't request an answer from YOU dear Kronos, so silence thy tongue. *turns to looks at you gently*

HI20.speaker: Narrator
HI20.text: Kronos is out of himself, as if still not recovering from the way he was treated. As for you, you don't really understand much of her odd way of speaking, but you suppose she's asking for the reason you're here

HI21.speaker: Player
HI21.text: Miss Benten, we are here to visit a friend of Kronos and I have to get an object back.

HI22.speaker: Narrator
HI22.text: At your words, her gaze turns sharp and her voice is still soft but now with an edge to it.

HI23.speaker: Benten
HI23.text: I see, You are most fortunate. I just happen to be in posession of the artifact your looking for.

HI24.speaker: Player
HI24.text: Pretty easy! you only have to win three games.

HI25.speaker: Player
HI25.text: against you? and can I choose the games? (with all his ego I guess he will be an easy opponent).

HI26.speaker: Kronos
HI26.text: Oh no no, you? playing against the almighty kronos? no, no that can't be, I don't play with brats. Besides I don't have the objects duh if you win against me you would gain nothing.

HI27.speaker: Kronos
HI27.text: *sighs* what you have to do is win against some of my *ehem* friends, who happened to recover them for me. However, for reasons you little brain won't understand I can't ask them to return them.

HI28.speaker: Kronos
HI28.text: Anyway, win the games, I get my objects back and you get your beloved yarn. Do we have a deal?

HI29.speaker: Player
HI29.text: (He seems shaddy, but I really want my yarn back ugh). Alr, we have a deal

HI30.speaker: Narrator
HI30.text: kronos and you, paw with paw together and a there's a faint glow that goes away as fast as it came, this mean the deal has been sealed.

HI31.speaker: Kronos
HI31.text: Well, it's done, but first you have to get with me in my box, this is how we will get around.

HI32.speaker: Player
HI32.text: The box? how are we supposed to get around in that junk?

HI33.speaker: Kronos
HI33.text: Oh, just shut it and get on!

HI34.speaker: Narrator
HI34.text: you reluctantly get in the box, and when you're inside, you're shocked to see it has a lot more space than it appeared to have from the outside.

end.speaker: Kronos
end.text: Well, welcome to my 'little' home haha. Now, because I'm the kindest cat around here, I'll let you choose where you wanna go first.
